notes.title: Bendy: Lone Wolf
notes.content:
[b]Boris and the Dark Survival[/b] will be transforming into [b]Bendy: Lone Wolf[/b], along with a rebrand will have a large overhaul of the entire game. This means that [b]Bendy: Lone Wolf[/b] will be a completely new game on steam that will build on the foundation of [b]Boris and the Dark Survival[/b] but expand it into a full featured experience. Upon release, [b]Boris and the Dark Survival[/b] will be discontinued. However, anybody who owns [b]Boris and the Dark Survival[/b] will receive a free copy of [b]Bendy: Lone Wolf[/b]. We hope you will join Boris as his dark survival finally unfolds to a conclusion.

[h3]What's New?[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Features
[*] New Combat
[*] New Conclusion
[*] New Enemies
[*] New Bosses
[*] New Weapons
[*] New Achievements
[*] New Mini Games
[*] New Hazards
[*] Same Boris
[/list]
Bendy: Lone Wolf will release in 2025!
